## Approach: [NaviGait]{.smallcaps}
[NaviGait]{.smallcaps} structurally separates RL from trajectory optimization.

1. Synthesize underlying gait library $\mathcal{G}$ via trajectory optimization.
2. Use RL to strategcally select and correct motion plans in $\mathcal{G}$.
